system.unidentifiedDesc: A mysterious 3' foot long rod with strange markings.
system.description:
Usable by any character, this rod makes the user lucky in war (when the War Machine mass combat system is used). The following bonuses apply to that system:

A + 25 bonus applies to the Combat Results roll (to a maximum total of 100).

On the Combat Results Table, if the difference in overall totals is 101 or more, the result for "91-100" is used, limiting the number of casualties.
